column2: Landscape 3:2 (1536x1024), touchscreen point-of-sale app for small businesses in Morocco, named "Atlas POS" (placeholder name). Shared visual style: modern, calm and very touch-friendly; light warm-grey background #F4F5F7, deep navy #14213D top bar, teal #0FA3A3 as the action colour, amber #F2A541 for warnings, white cards with 14px rounded corners and soft shadows, very large touch targets (buttons at least 72px tall), bold geometric sans-serif font, generous spacing, clear hierarchy. Prices in "DH" (Moroccan dirham), for example "38,00 DH". All labels in French. Screen: step 2 of 6 of the technician installation wizard. A left vertical stepper with 6 steps: "1 Langue", "2 Type d'activité" (current, highlighted), "3 Entreprise", "4 Matériel", "5 Utilisateurs", "6 Sauvegardes". Title "Quel type d'activité ?". Four big selectable cards with simple line icons: "Restaurant" (selected, teal border and check mark), "Café / Snack", "Boulangerie", "Commerce". Below, a panel "Modules activés" with large toggle switches: "Plan de salle" ON, "Cuisine" ON, "Menus" ON, "Clients" ON, "Stock" OFF, "Code-barres" OFF, "Balance" OFF. Bottom bar with a grey "Retour" button and a large teal "Suivant" button.
